_readme: User-keyed tables that are deliberately NOT in app_private.export_my_data (the PDPA export), each with the reason. src/lib/services/supabase/export-completeness-contracts.test.ts fails when a table that references user_profiles or auth.users is in neither the latest export function nor this list. Prefer adding the table to the export; list it here only when it holds no personal content of the user's own, and say why.

tables.guest_sessions: Legacy scaffold from migration 0008; no app code reads or writes it. Holds a device id and expiry only.
tables.orders: Legacy scaffold from migration 0008; no app code reads or writes it.
tables.chat_messages: Legacy scaffold from migration 0008, superseded by messages (exported as messagesSent); no app code writes it.
tables.dishes_draft: Ops review queue of menu drafts from photo extraction; claimed_by is the reviewer, not content the user created.
tables.conversations: Exported through conversation_participants and messagesSent; the conversation row holds no personal content of its own.
tables.read_receipts: Delivery markers (message id and time read) rather than content; removed at account deletion. Revisit if a PDPA request asks for them.
tables.moderation_actions: Security, moderation and legal records; the export's notIncluded list tells users to email support for these.
tables.home_feed_items: Derived feed cache rebuilt from posts; not data the user provided.
tables.app_ops_admins: Staff access list, not end-user data.
tables.app_ops_audit_events: Security audit records (see notIncluded in the export).
tables.app_ops_rate_limits: Rate-limit counters and abuse-protection logs (see notIncluded in the export).
tables.app_user_rate_limits: Rate-limit counters and abuse-protection logs (see notIncluded in the export).
tables.public_profiles: Public copy of user_profiles fields kept in sync by trigger; the profile category already exports the source row.
tables.portfolio_flags: Lists the user reported are moderation records (see notIncluded in the export).
tables.website_console_admins: Staff access list, not end-user data.
tables.dish_flavor_tags: Shared flavour tags on dishes; the only user link is reviewed_by, the ops reviewer, not content the user created.
tables.user_push_tokens: Device identifiers used only to deliver alerts (see notIncluded in the export).
